deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds a causal link ('because'), asserting that benign tumours are extremely common because it takes a great deal for a benign tumour to become malignant. The source text mentions these as separate statements without claiming that one causes the other.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So benign tumors are actually incredibly common. Right? So it actually takes a lot for a benign tumor to become malignant in terms of, as I said, the number of changes that have to happen within a tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Benign tumours are extremely common, because it takes a great deal for a benign tumour to become malignant, given the number of changes that have to happen within a tumour.

considerations.sourcePassage: So just talking about incidence, about how often various tumors arise.
considerations.reason: Phrasing this as a definition ('Incidence describes how often various tumours arise') accurately reflects the meaning of the spoken explanation without adding unsourced information.
